description.content:
Welcome to the Shyft Customer App API.

Shyft customer App API is designed to support the function of Shyft Mobile App(iOS, Android), Web App and Manager Dashboard.

NOTES:

- In parameters section, the letter `R` stands for `Required`.
    
- All API examples show only essential data set.
    

## Authentication

---

Include as headers for API calls after authentication token.

| Name | Values | R | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Session-Uukey |  | \* | The value got from authentication API call (SignIn/Confirm) |

## Global Information

---

#### Query Parameters

###### For All API:

| Name | Values | R | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| api_version | String |  | Ex. 6_0_0 |
| response\[nested\] | Integer |  | Ex. 1 |
| response\[keep\] | String |  | Ex. location\[current_user_privilege\],name,id |
| response\[only\] | String |  | Ex. id,location\[id,location_name,current_user_privilege\] |
| response\[except\] | String |  | Ex. name,location\[id,location_name,swift_code\],owner\[id\] |

- The query parameter `response[only]` is needed to help API performance by limiting the size of returned data.
    
- On test server, `response[only]` support wildcard, you can supply `response[only]=\*` to get everything.
    
- Production server does not support wildcard, you need to figure out and supply your `response[only]` for each API call.
    

###### For Index API:

- Pagination Option 1)
    

| Name | Values | R | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| page | Integer |  | Ex. 1 |
| per_page | Integer |  | Ex. 5 |
| total | boolean |  | true/false |
| order | String |  | Ex. start_at_desc, start_at_asc |

- Pagination Option 2)
    

| Name | Values | R | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| limit | Integer |  | Ex. 10 |
| offset | Integer |  | Ex. 5 |
| order | String |  | Ex. start_at_desc, start_at_asc |
| last_id | Integer |  | Ex. 101 |

###### For Update API:

| Name | Values | R | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| response\[put_return_resource\] | String |  | Ex. true |

#### Headers

| Name | Values | R | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Platform | ios|android|web | \* |  |
| Api-Version | 6_0_0 | \* | Ex: 6_0_0 |
| Build-Number |  | \* |  |
| Push-Id |  |  |  |
| X-Method |  |  | Deprecated |
| Content-Type | application/json | \* |  |

#### Success Codes

| SUCCESS Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Created -- Objet created. |
| 201 | Unauthorized -- Your API key is wrong. |
| 204 | No Content -- Success without returning resource. |

#### Error Codes

| Error Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 400 | Bad Request -- Your request is invalid. |
| 401 | Unauthorized -- Your API key is wrong. |
| 403 | Forbidden -- The records requested is hidden for administrators only. |
| 404 | Not Found -- The specified record could not be found. |
| 405 | Method Not Allowed -- You tried to access a record with an invalid method. |
| 406 | Not Acceptable -- You requested a format that isn't json. |
| 410 | Gone -- The record requested has been removed from our servers. |
| 422 | Unprocessable Entity -- Invalid input data. |
| 429 | Too Many Requests -- You're requesting too many requests! Slow down! |
| 500 | Internal Server Error -- We had a problem with our server. Try again later. |
| 502 | Bad Gateway -- |
| 504 | Gateway Timeout -- |
| 503 | Service Unavailable -- We're temporarily offline for maintenance. Please try again later. |
